Admin

How do I create an invoice?

✦

Ask CurveAI Assistant

To create an invoice for a patient, follow these steps:

1. In the Sidekick, locate the patient’s account.
2. Click on the “Billing” Module.
3. Click the “Add invoice” button.
4. The “Line item selector” dialog box will appear. Select the applicable line items for the invoice and click “Add.”
5. Review the selected line items in the “Add invoice” section and click “Add” to create the new invoice.
